```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Snake Game</title>
    <style>
        body {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            margin: 0;
            background-color: #f0f0f0;
        }
        #game-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 400px;
            height: 400px;
            border: 1px solid #000;
        }
        #snake {
            position: absolute;
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            background-color: #00f;
        }
        #food {
            position: absolute;
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            background-color: #f00;
        }
        #score {
            position: absolute;
            top: 10px;
            left: 10px;
            font-size: 20px;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="game-container">
        <div id="score">Score: 0</div>
        <div id="snake"></div>
        <div id="food"></div>
    </div>
    <script>
        const gameContainer = document.getElementById('game-container');
        const snake = document.getElementById('snake');
        const food = document.getElementById('food');
        const scoreElement = document.getElementById('score');

        let snakeX = 200;
        let snakeY = 200;
        let foodX = Math.floor(Math.random() * 38) * 20;
        let foodY = Math.floor(Math.random() * 38) * 20;
        let dx = 20;
        let dy = 0;
        let score = 0;
        let snakeBody = [];

        function drawSnake() {
            snake.style.left = snakeX + 'px';
            snake.style.top = snakeY + 'px';
        }

        function drawFood() {
            food.style.left = foodX + 'px';
            food.style.top = foodY + 'px';
        }

        function moveSnake() {
            snakeX += dx;
            snakeY += dy;

            if (snakeX < 0 || snakeX >= 400 || snakeY < 0 || snakeY >= 400) {
                alert('Game Over! Your score: ' + score);
                resetGame();
            }

            for (let i = 0; i < snakeBody.length; i++) {
                if (snakeX === snakeBody[i].x && snakeY === snakeBody[i].y) {
                    alert('Game Over! Your score: ' + score);
                    resetGame();
                }
            }

            snakeBody.push({ x: snakeX, y: snakeY });

            if (snakeX === foodX && snakeY === foodY) {
                score++;
                scoreElement.textContent = 'Score: ' + score;
                foodX = Math.floor(Math.random() * 38) * 20;
                foodY = Math.floor(Math.random() * 38) * 20;
                drawFood();
            } else {
                snakeBody.shift();
            }

            drawSnake();
        }

        function resetGame() {
            snakeX = 200;
            snakeY = 200;
            dx = 20;
            dy = 0;
            score = 0;
            snakeBody = [];
            scoreElement.textContent = 'Score: ' + score;
            drawSnake();
            drawFood();
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
            switch (event.key) {
                case 'ArrowUp':
                    if (dy === 0) {
                        dx = 0;
                        dy = -20;
                    }
                    break;
                case 'ArrowDown':
                    if (dy === 0) {
                        dx = 0;
                        dy = 20;
                    }
                    break;
                case 'ArrowLeft':
                    if (dx === 0) {
                        dx = -20;
                        dy = 0;
                    }
                    break;
                case 'ArrowRight':
                    if (dx === 0) {
                        dx = 20;
                        dy = 0;
                    }
                    break;
            }
        });

        drawSnake();
        drawFood();
        setInterval(moveSnake, 100);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
